name: Marah
verdict: Marah is a Saudi shopping app owned and operated by Meatsteak Company, a registered private company in Riyadh. Nothing found.
note: Sleeve (shoulder) sponsor of Al-Fayha 2026-27 (club announcement of 17 August 2026, signed by Meatsteak CEO Abdulaziz bin Saad Al-Mousa). Individual shareholders of Meatsteak Company are not public.
